prompts.cover: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide GitHub README banner, landscape approximately 2.5:1. Create a polished editorial illustration for the project "Awesome Research Skills" and its real website skill.createsci.com. A warm off-white background, precise navy typography and cobalt blue / pale cyan accents, slight printed paper texture, generous whitespace, scientific publication design. Left half is beautifully typeset headline, right half a refined tactile paper sculpture / editorial collage of a research workflow: open journal pages, a small data plot, a method diagram, an editable slide card; linked by subtle fine lines. Art should feel intelligent and useful, not a sci-fi AI advertisement. Text exactly, no other text: "Awesome Research Skills" (large headline on two lines), "找到好工具，也找到好用法。" (Chinese subheading), "skill.createsci.com" (clearly legible website address). Keep every glyph correct, headline uncut, large margins, sharp readable type at a GitHub rendered width of 850px. Do not include resource counts, install buttons, QR codes, robots, third party logos, fabricated interface screenshots, watermarks, or decorative gibberish. This is a project cover illustration, not a real product screenshot.
prompts.tutorials: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: illustrated research tutorial roadmap banner for a Chinese GitHub resource library, landscape approximately 2:1. A calm clean scientific editorial style on warm off-white with navy, cobalt blue and pale cyan, generous whitespace, very readable typography. Design one elegant continuous horizontal journey in four illustrated stages: a stack of research papers with magnifying lens, opened PDF pages with a highlighted table, a small data plot with a notebook, a presentation slide with an editable method diagram. Each stage is hand-crafted paper collage with subtle depth and crisp line detail, simple narrow arrows between stages. This is a proposed learning route, not a status dashboard. Text exactly: title "科研工具教程计划"; small subtitle "从一个问题，到一份可检查的结果"; four stage labels "找文献", "读论文", "做分析", "做汇报"; small footer "skill.createsci.com". No other text. Do not mark any stage complete or published. No claims of tested tools, invented charts with numbers, installation claims, code snippets, brand logos, QR codes, robots, watermarks. Chinese text must be correct and legible when shown at 850px width.
